title: Frontend: Calculator
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Calculator. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Parse a single binary arithmetic expression with finite signed decimal numbers and one of + - * /. Ignore outside/operator whitespace. Return the numeric result. Reject invalid grammar or division by zero with Invalid expression. Do not use eval. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Expression. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Tokenize a documented grammar and parse operator precedence with a stack or parser.
alternativeApproaches: Add parentheses with a real grammar and separate numeric precision policy from input parsing.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Operator precedence; unary minus; decimal input.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
